newsitem.title: USA: ITT board again votes against Hilton bid.
newsitem.headline: ITT board again votes against Hilton bid.

text.p: ITT Corp said Wednesday that its board of directors had again voted unanimously to recommend that ITT shareholders reject Hilton Hotels Corp's hostile takeover bid as "inadequate" and not in the best interests of the company.

Hilton Hotels is seeking to acquire 50.1 percent of ITT shares at $55 a share. ITT, which owns the Sheraton brand hotels and Caesars brand casinos, has rejected the bid and is refocusing its strategy on core hotel and gambling assets.

In a statement that outlined its plan to split into three separate companies, ITT Corp said, "The ITT Board reaffirmed its belief that the interests of ITT shareholders, as well as ITT employees, creditors, customers and the communities in which it operates, would best be served by the company remaining independent and executing its plan."
